name: Unnerving Howl
description: Upon first hearing the howls of a creature, a creature must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful, or the effect ends, the creature is immune to the creature's howl for 24 hours.
